raw_evidence: Auto-hold alert: transformation, data key, error code, ship-to ID
reported_symptom: Inbound PO moved to hold with a numeric error code
decoded_meaning: Ship-to location has no cross-reference to a distribution center
root_cause: Ship-to ID not in cross-reference; 13-digit ID fails the GS1 check digit, so likely a DUNS+4 or zero-padded partner code
preventive_control: Pre-validate ship-to at receipt with ID normalization (scirm/prevalidate.py)
business_impact: Order cannot release to the warehouse
security_relevance: Integrity: unknown locations must not auto-map

raw_evidence: User email + screenshot of the same error
reported_symptom: Sales order edits to fix delivery dates fail on save
decoded_meaning: Requested date ignores lead time; save re-runs the ship-to check that fails in SC-0001
root_cause: Same root cause as SC-0001, exposed by a manual date edit; upstream system does not apply lead time
preventive_control: Lead-time check at receipt; log manual changes to EDI-originated orders
security_relevance: Audit: manual overrides on EDI orders
